name: Securities Financing Transaction Details 55
definition: Details of the closing of the securities financing transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingTradeIdentification.name: Securities Financing Trade Identification
SecuritiesFinancingTradeIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the underlying securities financing trade as assigned by the instructing party. The identification is common to all collateral pieces (one or many).

SecuritiesFinancingUniqueTransactionIden.name: Securities Financing Unique Transaction Identifier
SecuritiesFinancingUniqueTransactionIden.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

ClosingLegIdentification.name: Closing Leg Identification
ClosingLegIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the second leg of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party acting on its behalf).

TerminationDate.name: Termination Date
TerminationDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies whether the rate is fixed or variable.

MaturityDateModification.name: Maturity Date Modification
MaturityDateModification.definition: Indicates whether the maturity date of the securities financing transaction may be modified.

InterestPayment.name: Interest Payment
InterestPayment.definition: Indicates whether the interest is to be paid to the collateral taker. If set to no, the interest is paid to the collateral giver.

VariableRateSupport.name: Variable Rate Support
VariableRateSupport.definition: Index or support rate used together with the spread to calculate the repurchase rate.

RepurchaseRate.name: Repurchase Rate
RepurchaseRate.definition: Rate to be used to recalculate the repurchase amount.

TransactionCallDelay.name: Transaction Call Delay
TransactionCallDelay.definition: Minimum number of days' notice a counterparty needs for terminating the transaction.

AccruedInterestAmount.name: Accrued Interest Amount
AccruedInterestAmount.definition: Interest amount that has accrued in between coupon payment periods.

TerminationTransactionAmount.name: Termination Transaction Amount
TerminationTransactionAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be settled to terminate the transaction.

SecondLegNarrative.name: Second Leg Narrative
SecondLegNarrative.definition: Provides additional information about the second leg in narrative form.
